title: Iair
summary: Raleigh names Iair in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iair the sonne of Manasse, who named Hauoth Iair. Not the judge Jair. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter V, §. VIII, sig. 205b–206a
